title: Debug the range sum
prompt: `sumRange(lo, hi)` should return lo + (lo+1) + ... + hi, both ends inclusive. It fails for every call. Trace the loop with lo=2, hi=4 (expected 9) to find the flaw, then fix it minimally.

tests.name: inclusive both ends
tests.hint: The test i < hi skips the last value; i <= hi fixes it.
